# Exploratory Data Analysis in R

## Import data

```{r} 
# import the file
data = readr::read_csv('data/survey_results_public.csv')

```

## View data
```{r}
# inspect the file
head(data)
```

```{r}
tail(data)
```
```{r}
# columns
colnames(data)

```


```{r}
# rows

row.names(data)

```


## Exercise
- Read your data into R and view it

## Select data
### Using position

```{r}
# single row
single_row <- data[3,]
single_row
```
```{r}
# single column
single_col <- data[,3]
single_col

```

```{r}
# range
many_rows <- data[3:6,]
many_rows
```

```{r}
many_cols <- data[,3:6]
many_cols
```

### Using labels

```{r}
remote_work_col <- data[, 'RemoteWork']
remote_work_col
```

### using condition

```{r}
remote_pos_response <- subset(data, RemoteWork == 'Remote')
remote_pos_response
```


## Plotting Data

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=data, aes(x=WorkExp)) +
         geom_histogram()
```
